Signatures: v2 and v3 verified; existing signing certificate preserved.

Delivered behavior:
- Optional ordinary user account: Settings -> Account -> register/login/profile/logout.
- Guest mode remains available for existing camera, preset and photo functions.
- Registration automatically signs in. Username is canonical lowercase; password spaces are preserved.
- Session is stored with an AndroidKeyStore AES-256/GCM key outside backup; no saved password.
- Restored/offline identities are visibly unverified until an online account check succeeds.
- Account networking runs independently from the camera worker.
- All Activities share the account repository; stale requests cannot restore a locally logged out identity.
- Local logout cleanup failure is retryable, blocks account reuse, and still attempts server revocation.
- Admin user management shows usernames and distinguishes password and QQ providers.

Local and live server checks:
- Account Java host regression: 107 checks passed, including failed local cleanup and shared-repository races.
- Backend Node tests: 63 passed; JavaScript syntax/source checks: 24 modules passed.
- Real PostgreSQL migration 003 applied; 28 password assertions passed in a rollback-only transaction.
- Real HTTPS password workflow: 32 named checks passed, including the production Java account transport's 9 checks.
- Production workflow covers register, duplicate name, wrong password, profile, admin search/detail,
  admin isolation, disable/revoke, re-enable/new login, logout replay and exact fixture cleanup.
- Live reports: online-library/build/password-workflow-verification.json and
  online-library/build/password-database-verification.json.

Native runtime: Pixel 9 Android 17 / API 37 emulator; exact product APK above.
- Guest Settings entry and preset library accessible without login.
- Real synthetic account registered and automatically entered the profile screen.
- Force-stop/restart restored identity through actual AndroidKeyStore-backed storage.
- Offline profile retained the identity, displayed unverified state and a network error.
- Wrong password showed a Chinese error and cleared the password input.
- Moving to Home and returning cleared the transient password input.
- Correct password signed in; light and dark account screens inspected.
- Logout returned to guest Settings; existing two synthetic local presets remained visible.
- Same-certificate isolated Instrumentation: 24 present-storage checks and 6 absent-storage checks passed.
  It checked the real private file envelope, non-exportable AES-256/GCM key, in-memory decryption,
  correct synthetic identity/token shape, absence of password fields and absence of plaintext account
  data in ciphertext. After logout, key alias and session/bak/new files were absent.
- Instrumentation only ran on emulator-5554; product manifest/APK were not changed for testing.
- Both live-workflow and UI synthetic accounts were ownership-checked and removed. Global rate-limit
  counters and all unrelated users, preset rows and files were preserved.

Limits of this verification:
- This version was not installed on the connected physical phone.
- No real camera, physical Wi-Fi/USB connection, live-photo transfer or lock-screen regression was added.
- Runtime storage deletion failure was covered through host fault injection, not device fault injection.
- The instrumentation helper was a temporary emulator-only package, not part of the distributed APK.
